rationale.intuition: RISD overall ~22-25%, ED admit rate substantially higher (~35-45%) per published cases. Portfolio is THE primary signal (60-70% of decision weight); Scholastic National Gold Medal in target medium + RISD Pre-College affiliation are industry-recognized portfolio strength markers. GPA 3.6 / SAT 1380 are well within admit range (RISD admit pool median ~3.6 GPA, SAT mid-50% ~1280-1450). Engine 会触发 ART_DESIGN audition_or_portfolio_admission 分支 → probability=0 sentinel。这个 fixture expose engine 在 portfolio 学校的 declining-to-predict 行为 vs industry consensus 20-50% 区间 for ED + strong portfolio markers.
